device.basis: Clock bank of X-T20 2.11 section 5: table 0xed5538 lists five PLLs as (configuration, configuration, control, lock bit) = (+0x28, +0x2c, +0x30, 2), (+0x34, +0x38, +0x3c, 4), (+0x40, +0x44, +0x48, 16), (+0x4c, +0x50, +0x54, 8), (+0x78, +0x7c, +0x80, 1); 0xc6aa74 sets control bit 26 and polls +0x6c for the lock bit, 0xc6aa30 clears bit 26. +0x58..+0x64 hold paired 12-bit divider fields (0xc6ae68) and 0xc6a6e0 polls divider busy bits at +0x68, which read clear. The lock time is an assumed 100 us in 48 MHz ticks; it is not measured.
